notes.title: Update to One by one: current word list
notes.notes:
New Feature: +1 View full list and current line
The "don't randomize but go one by one" button got a right click menu to show all the filtered words, have the current marked and click to jump to specific word. 

Quality of life improvements:
Paste a word list, seperated by new line into the first column. (useful when pasting from ChatGPT)

Couldn't delete folders
Some adding new folder crash

notes.title: Ctrl/Alt+Enter added to paste procedures / Drop window updates
notes.notes:
*To better support Stable Diffusion Alt/Ctrl+Enter is now available in the AI profile paste procedure commands.
*AI profiles gui has been slightly updated
*Added stable defusion as 2nd preset
*Standard paste procedure is now Wtwtwcpwwwwwwwte, it seems to better work with Discord 
*New: Text drop page now has options for directly using dropped text as prompt or split & prompt

notes.title: New layouts menu, steam cloud support, download folders menu updates
notes.notes:
Updating the recent features: 
.Prompt layout menu reworked
.Activated Steam cloud so your libraries are saved
.Download folder button now opens folder overview (style will be better on next update)
You can drop to folders, right-click delete, and left-click open. 
.Pin by holding Ctrl when picking a word 
.Some GUI updates to words in prompts and word dictionary checkboxes

notes.title: Previous functionality ++
notes.notes:
Couple of functions have been added. They are functional but not completely finished yet: 
1. Dropzones in full window now, for images you can drop into one of the added folders
2. Selected Wordtypes can now be pulled in from all the themes
3. Hiding section buttons have been updated
4. Prompt layouts have been added above the prompt box. 

I think the default functionality should be restored for now, 
further fixes will follow soon!

notes.title: Beta hotfixes
notes.notes:
Beta patch
The following points have been fixed in beta:

*Several changes to the main view (some things have been omitted, give feedback if you miss anything!)
*Fixed download folders button issues
*Parameters settings have been further updated, can now be repositioned
*A new parameter type has been added: Button. To send simple commands like /info to AI.
*Using ctrl+enter is not confusing discord anymore
*Esc in wordsearchmenu aborts the change
*Further fixes to word menu
*To split words (by commas and engine markers) hold shift while confirming a filter/word

(to access the beta, find art ai compass in your steam library, go to properties, betas, enter password: magneticfield and select the beta)

notes.title: New version incomming! Requested updates and more.
notes.notes:
I was finally able to make a new update, it's a bit rough around the edges but i'm sure you'll like it. It should take over all you word themes and settings without problems, but just in case before updating, in you Steam library go to AI Art compass > manage > local folder and make a copy.
The beta password is magneticfield.

List of updates
*The static word group names have been updated with customizable ones =>
*To roll random words, a filtering system is being used, like: *Animals*Small or: *HomogenousTheme or **AllThemesAnimals
*Themes and Ai settings parameters gui was updated

Writing prompts has been updated
*Commans in input text is now automatically seperated, as well es promptcommands (-- for MJ)
*"send enter" button has been added, in cases MJ hangs at sending enter
*Hold Ctrl when moving words to duplicate

Further workflow udpates
*The download button can be rightlicked now to show most used directories
*A pane now shows last downloaded images, just to know where you stopped
*Middle click on parameters (MJ stylize or chaos) randomizes the values
*Randomize weights with middle click

New hotkeys
*Ctrl+enter to paste (can't be hit fast though because windows switch back and forth) 
*Ctrl+shift+enter roll and paste
*INS key now loads selected text from history (next to pulling into window)
*Word under cursor search was changed to F3
*Prompt adapter moved to Ctrl+Home

Hope you like the update let me know what you think or need! 
Libor
